searchText: phase two — revenue failure attack revenue cannot be guaranteed; engineering can only improve discoverability, value, conversion, retention, and unit economics. do not add dark patterns, fake scarcity, forced paywalls, or pay to win mechanics. do not publish seo pages whose product route is broken or whose capability is unavailable. do not track private user content in analytics. do not let marketing metadata drift from canonical product identity. do not spend credits before value is provably delivered. do not lose user work when login/purchase intervenes. do not introduce subscription commitments before cancellation/refund/support policy exists. do not scale acquisition before core product performance and mobile quality are measurable. do not optimize conversion without tracking post purchase success and retention.

title: Twenty Immediate Improvements To The Plan

headings.text: Twenty Immediate Improvements To The Plan

excerpt: Twenty Immediate Improvements To The Plan 1. Prove the launcher exists in a production faithful browser before changing product pages. 2. Use canonical catalog metadata instead of duplicating descriptions in generated SEO artifacts. 3. Separate public experiences from canonical monetizable products so commerce claims n
searchText: twenty immediate improvements to the plan 1. prove the launcher exists in a production faithful browser before changing product pages. 2. use canonical catalog metadata instead of duplicating descriptions in generated seo artifacts. 3. separate public experiences from canonical monetizable products so commerce claims never leak onto noncanonical entries. 4. keep static crawlable inventory accessible as html while runtime js progressively enhances it. 5. avoid hidden duplicate links/cards that confuse screen readers when js hydration starts. 6. generate sitemaps from resolved public routes rather than filesystem guessing. 7. include canonical urls and social metadata only for routes that actually resolve. 8. add json ld softwareapplication/videogame only when required fields are truthful. 9. keep private product content, filenames, transcripts, documents, prompts, and source code out of telemetry. 10. define one event vocabulary before instrumenting multiple products. 11. measure paid outcome success, not merely checkout clicks. 12. measure return after purchase so lost context checkout failures become visible. 13. add readiness failure when live credit packs exist without live handler backed value. 14. add readiness failure when a public catalog route has no crawlable title/description/link. 15. add readiness failure when js files violate header/tab/<120 laws in touched systems. 16. time cold start stages individually instead of guessing which initializer stalls http bind. 17. do not optimize cold start by skipping required durability/security initialization. 18. preserve current interactive apps/games sorting/search even after static crawlable content exists. 19. make generated artifacts deterministic so ci can detect drift. 20. verify generated pages with both source inspection and browser behavior before claiming acquisition readiness.

title: Thirty Further Improvements Before Execution

searchText: thirty further improvements before execution 1. prefer additive modules over enlarging existing controllers. 2. keep action catalog reads cacheable while account ownership remains private/no store. 3. add explicit schema/version fields to generated product metadata. 4. build related product edges from categories/tags only when evidence exists. 5. preserve hebrew titles and descriptions without corrupting directionality. 6. ensure static fallback cards have semantic headings and descriptive links. 7. avoid duplicate h1 elements after runtime enhancement. 8. give every catalog card one clear primary action. 9. keep marketplace copy outcome focused rather than feature jargon heavy. 10. avoid unsupported claims such as “best,” “instant,” or “ai powered” when product metadata does not prove them. 11. track activation only after meaningful use, not page load. 12. track store open source so acquisition paths can be compared without user content logging. 13. track insufficient credit state separately from checkout failure. 14. track reservation release reason for operational health, not advertising profiles. 15. add sampling/aggregation if telemetry volume could become expensive. 16. ensure analytics failures never break product functionality. 17. add deterministic test fixtures for public product graph generation. 18. add duplicate route/product id detection. 19. add broken relative asset/link detection for generated landing surfaces. 20. add mobile overflow checks for long product titles. 21. add reduced motion checks for premium decoration. 22. add keyboard traversal checks for commerce and catalog surfaces. 23. add color contrast review hooks to visual qa. 24. add readiness summaries by app/game/category so long tail products are visible. 25. record startup stage duration in monotonic time. 26. expose startup diagnostics only to logs/health tooling, never public customer apis unless sanitized. 27. keep the test validator outside product source; never ship temporary test server code accidentally. 28. stop/clean validation processes after browser verification. 29. re read all touched files after each write wave and compare planned vs actual. 30. end only with explicit remaining work and next action if any safe useful work remains.
